name: eventlab-workspace
description: Workspace root for EventLab, a testing toolkit for unreliable event delivery.

scripts.test:nextjs: npm run build --prefix examples/frameworks/nextjs && tsc -p examples/frameworks/nextjs/tsconfig.check.json && vitest run --config examples/frameworks/nextjs/vitest.config.ts
scripts.api: api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/cli/api-extractor.json
scripts.api:check: api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c packages/cli/api-extractor.json
